reasoning: Trump won the 2024 election and took office in January 2025. The evidence clearly shows he implemented sweeping tariffs throughout 2025, with the effective U.S. tariff rate reaching nearly 17% by November 2025—seven times higher than in January and the highest since 1935. Tariffs generated over $236 billion in revenue by November 2025. While the Supreme Court struck down some tariffs in February 2026, this was after 2025 ended. The question asks if tariffs went up in 2025 given Trump won, which clearly happened. This satisfies the 'Yes' resolution condition.
